citation.authors: Garrison SR, Korownyk CS, Kolber MR, Allan GM et al

cited_by.title: Magnesium supplements for sleep and cramps

record.population: People with skeletal muscle cramps in 11 randomised trials (five in pregnancy, five idiopathic, one cirrhosis)
record.design: Cochrane systematic review of magnesium supplements for cramp prevention
record.finding: For idiopathic cramps, largely in older adults (mean age about 62 to 69), cramp frequency differences between magnesium and placebo were small and statistically non-significant (moderate-certainty evidence). The pregnancy and cirrhosis trials were at high risk of bias.
record.note: Ethnicity not reported in the abstract.
